content:
I have written custom css for my notes on Lean. The original motivation was to make the margin notes look nicer on narrow screens (I am using a laptop a lot), but I ended making quite substantial modifications inspired by Tufte CSS.

I’m sharing this here because a more bookish, less manual-like style may be of broader interest. The style requires a couple of hacks "documented" here. If there is wider interest, these could perhaps be implemented properly in verso.
